rows.author: K126;
rows.title_full: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR THE CRIMINALIZATION OF RED-TAGGING
rows.abstract:
Defines “Red-Tagging as the act of publicly labeling, vilifying, branding, naming, accusing or caricaturing individuals, groups, or organizations of being state enemies, subversives, armed rebels, communists or terrorists, or fronts thereof, thereby implying of insinuating involvement or engagement in armed rebellion, acts of terrorism or any wrongdoing or criminal acts . . . Provided further, . . . a disputable presumption that it was committed with the use of public position and/or of public funds attaches.
Provides for different forms of red-tagging; describes several offenses and their corresponding penalties which includes among others: punishment under R.A. 10353  ( Defining and Penalizing Enforced or Involuntary Disappearance;  perpetual absolute disqualification to hold public office; or filing of administrative and civil cases.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on JUSTICE since 2022-08-01

rows.title_full: AN ACT ADOPTING A 30-YEAR NATIONAL INFRASTRUCTURE PROGRAM
rows.abstract:
Proposes to cover major infrastructure projects of the National Government (NG) - the fields of transport and logistics, energy, water resources, information and communications technology, social, and agri-fisheries modernization and food logistics infrastructure - including projects under Public-Private Partnership (PPP) schemes and partnerships with Local Government Units.
Provides for priority initial list and brief description of core national projects which focuses on pipeline infrastructure; Tasks NEDA and DBM to see to it that the total annual budget allocation is at least five percent (5%) of the Gross Domestic Product, consistent with the long term expenditure framework and the budget ceilings set by the Development Budget Coordinating Committee; Provides for the use of applicable modern technology in the planning, procurement, and implementation of projects in the Program.
rows.status: Substituted by HB08078

rows.title_full: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE AGRICULTURE INFORMATION SYSTEM IN ALL CITIES AND MUNICIPALITIES
rows.abstract:
Aims to improve the country´s agricultural planning process through the establishment of a computer database that shall contain an up-to-date inventory of all agricultural commodities available in the various local communities, and where information on the demand is gathered simultaneously with the production data from farmers in every barangay as the platform for marketing nationwide.
Mandates LGUs to gather and consolidate all pertinent data on the profile and demographics of farmers and buyers, and to store these in their respective AIS, and to facilitate the free registration of all farmers, fisherfolks, as well as buyers transacting within their respective area in the information system.
rows.status: Substituted by HB07942

rows.title_full: AN ACT EXPANDING THE PURPOSES AND APPLICATION OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION FUND, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE SECTIONS 100 AND 272 OF REPUBLIC ACT NO. 7160, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LOCAL GOVERNMENT CODE OF 1991
rows.abstract:
Proposes to prioritize in the annual school board budget, provisions for the a) construction/ maintenance of administration offices, assembly halls, laboratories and improvements; operation and maintenance; school uniforms; early childhood care and development program, among existing others.
Seeks to allocate the proceeds of the additional one percent SEF Tax on real property for the following, among others:  construction/maintenance of different facilities and school´s improvement; payment of compensation and other benefits to teaching and non-teaching personnel”¦;  necessary extension classes; acquisition and titling of school sites; transport vehicles, equipment, and apparatus; books, periodicals, teaching aids, and instructional materials; educational researches, conferences, etc., sports development, other expenses necessary or incident to the operation and maintenance of public schools which are not sufficiently provided for in the regular appropriation of the Department of Education.
